summary.text: Jonathon Acosta is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 16 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jonathon Acosta was born in New York City and earned a bachelor's degree (2011) and two master's degrees (2016 and 2019) from Brown University.
His career experience includes working as a dean and middle school administrator.
Acosta took office on January 5, 2021, succeeding Elizabeth Crowley, and was assigned to the Senate Finance Committee and the Rules, Government Ethics and Oversight Committee for 2023-2024.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father, educator, Eagle Scout and youth wrestling coach who had been a middle school math teacher and a Central Falls city councilman representing Ward 1.
